title: The Menu, Week 4
dek: Three starting quarterbacks and four lead backs are off the menu, and Jaylen Warren walks into the top 10 on Thursday night.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Week 4 has no byes and a lot of empty chairs. Caleb Williams, Baker Mayfield and Jaxson Dart are out at quarterback, De'Von Achane and Jordan Mason are on IR, Travis Etienne is out for Monday night, and Breece Hall is week to week. Every one of them has a pivot listed under Off the Menu. Rankings are for full PPR.

The biggest moves come from the snap counts, not the box scores. Jaylen Warren goes to RB9 with Rico Dowdle sitting on two straight missed practices before Thursday's game at CLE. Aaron Jones Sr. moves into tier 3 on 78 percent of Minnesota's carries and a home game against the defense that has allowed the most points to running backs. Alvin Kamara comes up from the pantry into the RB2 range, and Braelon Allen and Chuba Hubbard into the flex range. Omarion Hampton drops five spots because his passing downs are gone, Emeka Egbuka and Chris Godwin fall with an undrafted rookie at quarterback, and Brian Thomas Jr. is down 20 spots on a 37 percent snap share.

Four questionable players hold their tier with a flag: Jayden Daniels, Puka Nacua, Nico Collins and Justin Jefferson. Each sits at the bottom of his tier until he practices. Prep Notes revisits every flag Friday after the final injury report and updates this page.
outro_md: Tiers are courses. The top of a tier is the safest plate; the bottom is where the flags live. A questionable player keeps his action and carries the flag until Friday. Specials are matchup plays outside the top tiers, and Off the Menu names the pivot for every player who is out.
